title: arenaria martrinii
intro: Arenaria martrinii, commonly known as mountain sandwort, is a plant species that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote digestive health and alleviate various symptoms such as nausea, diarrhea, and bloating. The therapeutic actions of Arenaria martrinii include its ability to act as a carminative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic agent, which helps to soothe the digestive system and reduce discomfort. The bioactive constituents of Arenaria martrinii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
